All of it is infrastructure, and the repositories consistently implement the domain's repository interfaces. The weakness is duplicated rules inside the controllers. OrderController hardcodes the set of valid order states as string literals in two places, with two different lists. That restates the domain's OrderState invariant and the allowed-transition rule at the HTTP edge instead of keeping it in one place. The two lists can drift from the domain and from each other.
